```{r include=FALSE}


# shared_data <- SharedData$new(all_spec_simd_pivot,
#                               # key = "specialty",
#                               group = ~specialty_description)

all_spec_simd_pivot2 <- all_spec_simd_pivot |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number(),
         `Specialty Description` = factor(`Specialty Description`))

shared_data <- SharedData$new(
  all_spec_simd_pivot2,
  key = ~row_id,
  group = "appointments"
)

```



## Background

The following document shows the outpatient DNA rate for The Tweed. 

Source: SMR00 (Outpatients), Public Health Scotland

Date of extraction: `r pretty_date(today())`

Period of interest: January 2023 to December 2025 [Inclusive]

Codes selected for the Mental Health grouping: `r select_specialties`

## DNA Rate Table - SIMD and Year

```{r, echo=FALSE}

filter_select(
  id = "specialty_filter",
  label = "Select Specialty",
  sharedData = shared_data,
  group = all_spec_simd_pivot2$`Specialty Description`
)

# Create table using the SharedData object
datatable(
  shared_data,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    # pageLength = 10,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(
        targets = 5,
        visible = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
)

```
